title: Bipartiteness via independence and edge covering numbers
statement: A finite simple graph $G$ is bipartite if and only if, for every subgraph $H$ of $G$ whose minimum degree $\delta(H)$ is positive, the independence number $\alpha(H)$ — the greatest number of pairwise nonadjacent vertices of $H$ — equals the edge covering number $\beta'(H)$.
hypotheses_covered: equivalence with $\alpha(H) = \beta'(H)$ holding for all such $H$
replaced:
(b) Show that $G$ is bipartite if and only if $\alpha(H) = \beta'(H)$ for every
subgraph $H$ of $G$ such that $\delta(H) > 0$.
